takeaways: Generative Pages turn a sentence into a working React page inside Power Apps, but clicking Edit Code turns managed configuration into source code the platform no longer maintains.
Code-edited pages inherit React version drift, npm dependency vulnerabilities, Dataverse schema drift and permission gaps that low-code governance cannot catch.
Contain the risk by moving edited pages to developer environments with version control and CI/CD review gates, and treat Edit Code as a one-way door with clear ownership.
hook: Generative Pages make it feel safe to let GPT build React pages inside Power Apps, until someone clicks Edit Code. This episode shows Power Platform makers, admins and CoE teams what technical debt and security risk that click creates and how to contain it with environments, reviews and ownership.
